a: VLT/VLTI and La Silla time from up to 5% of general observing time; programmes are generally under 5 hours
dt: Proposals may be submitted at any time through the p1 tool
e: ESO's channel for urgent targets of opportunity, highly competitive topics, quick follow-up of recent results and small feasibility tests that cannot wait for the next regular or Fast Track Channel call. Reviewed by a DDT committee; all co-Is need an ESO User Portal account.
unv: The DDT page does not state limits for PIs from non-member states; ESO's regular call accepts them and ranks them on merit, with preference to member-state proposals rated equally. Student PI rules not stated.
